parsed.notes: Actual ratio values are not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The Secured Net Leverage limit steps down to 4.00x starting with the quarter ending June 30, 2027 and can be raised by 0.50x for four quarters after a material acquisition (one-time election). Leverage-based pricing grids (margins/commitment fees) are excluded because they set pricing, not covenants.
